purpose: Adapter expansion for 07D global microscope-slide survey entries, prioritising Asia, southern Africa, Iberia, Smithsonian subcollections, and named historical batches.
guards: Fetch metadata pages only; do not bulk-download specimen images.
Preserve source relationship phrases and collection-level counts without converting them into ownership or item totals.
When one institutional page contains several slide subcollections, keep each explicit count and taxonomic scope separate.
Historical counts remain dated historical states and must not be projected into current holdings.

adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve the linkage between wood specimen and three-section microscope preparation; treat exchange statements as network evidence.

adapters.institution_scope: Lee Kong Chian Natural History Museum
adapters.target: official museum articles and collection pages naming the Microscope Slide Collection
expected_terms: Lee Kong Chian Natural History Museum
adapters.promotion_rule: Use official curator/collection language to establish collection existence; exact count and catalogue endpoint remain separate discovery tasks.
Keep bone histology and palynology as separate project-derived slide collections; preserve report/grid-reference links where stated.
